title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 102
paragraphs: Having taken Eretria, the Persians stayed a few days and then sailed for Attica, pressing on hard in the belief that the Athenians would behave just as the Eretrians had. And since Marathon was the place in Attica most suitable for cavalry and also closest to Eretria, it was there that Hippias son of Pisistratus was guiding them.
